name: Hollow Wretch
lore: A small Gateborn husk formed from erased memory. It attacks in groups and leaves cold silence behind when destroyed.
visualDescription: Thin charcoal humanoid shard-body, incomplete mask, white cracks, no faction marks.
mapBehavior: Rushes isolated Deities and punishes careless positioning.

scaling.campaign: Fixed mission bands; old wins should become easier as Divine Level and gear rise.

scaling.levelFormula: hp = baseHp * (1 + 0.045 * missionLevel); damage = baseDamage * (1 + 0.035 * missionLevel), capped by tier budget

aiProfile.counterplayWindow: Every major action has a telegraph or setup turn unless spawned as a minor swarmer.

balanceNotes: Harder solo tuning: Minor SWARMER pressures one active deity through behavior first, stats second; threatWeight 1.0 controls encounter budgets.
